name: Shammah
bio: Shammah son of Agee the Hararite was one of David's Three mightiest warriors. When the Israelite army fled from the Philistines at a field full of lentils, Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field and defended it alone, striking down the Philistines; the LORD brought about a great victory there (2 Samuel 23:11-12). Shammah was also among the three who later broke through a Philistine camp to bring David water from the well of Bethlehem, a gift David found too precious to drink and poured out to the LORD instead (2 Samuel 23:13-17).
